faces.name: Remnant of Hollowness

info.Card Set: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"

faces.text: Choose 1. If there are at least 10 cards in opponents' cemeteries, choose up to 2 instead. (1) Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 3 damage. If there are at least 10 cards in opponents' cemeteries, deal 8 damage instead. (2) Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Thief card from among them and add it to your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

qa.title: Q1948 (Jan. 16, 2026)
qa.question: If I choose options 1 and 2, can I add a Thief card to my hand before selecting an enemy follower on the field?
qa.answer: No. When required to select targets for any part of a card or ability, all targets must be selected before playing. So if you choose options 1 and 2, you first select an enemy follower on the field, resolve option 1, then resolve option 2.

faces.name: Melodious Monody

info.Card Set: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"

faces.text: As an additional cost to play this, you may engage any number of Idolatry cards on your field.
sections: Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it damage equal to 2 times the number of Idolatry cards you engaged as the additional cost to play this.

qa.title: Q1949 (Jan. 16, 2026)
qa.question: Can I play this spell without engaging any Idolatry cards on my field?
qa.answer: Yes, as long as you can select an enemy follower. This spell would do no damage, then be moved to the cemetery (then be removed from the game, as it is a token).

qa.title: Q1953 (Jan. 16, 2026)
qa.question: I have 10 cards in my cemetery and an evolved Crimson Rose Queen on my field. If I play a Scream Diffusion, does Crimson Rose Queen's automatic ability trigger 3 times?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't. Evolved Crimson Rose Queen's automatic ability only triggers when you play a card that originally costs 2, not when an ability summons one.
